prompt: Write a function that maps raw rows to Item objects and drops rows that fail to map.
setup: The repository has no assertion-related lint rules and compiles with TypeScript 5.5 or later.
Item is an existing exported type with required id and name fields.
expected: The mapped object's shape is checked with a return-type annotation or satisfies Item.
Undefined results are removed with a type predicate, inferred or explicit.
No type assertion appears; if one is unavoidable it sits at a trust boundary with a comment explaining why.
must_not: Assert a constructed object with as Item, which would hide a missing or misspelled field.
Cast a filtered array with as Item[] instead of narrowing it.
Use as unknown as T outside a validated trust boundary.
